context.note: Every public facade method MUST accept this as its first argument, named 'ctx'.

retrieval_guard.note: 已选择知识库但没有执行任何检索，模型却想直接收尾时记录一次拦截。

rules.tests: unittest tests collected by pytest; binary behavior replay is mandatory
rules.concurrency: sync methods that block IO are wrapped by caller via asyncio.to_thread

keyword_search.notes: 纯词面打分，不调用向量模型

hybrid_search.notes: 向量与词面排序的 RRF 融合

read_document.notes: 分页读取；默认只返回 DEFAULT_READ_CHUNKS 块，每个 Citation.metadata 含 chunk_index 与 total_chunks

document_info.notes: {source_id,title,knowledge_base_id,chunk_count}；未知 id 时 chunk_count 为 0

rag-tools.notes: RAG 工具模块：向 LLM 公布知识库检索工具，执行时只访问当前会话选中的知识库。

read_document.notes: source_id 必须属于所选知识库；分页读取，返回值含 total_chunks/truncated/next_offset

memory.storage: agent_data table in the shared six-table database

agent-runtime.notes: 已选择知识库时每个问题至少检索一次：未检索就想收尾会被打回（最多 MAX_RETRIEVAL_REMINDERS 次）并记录 retrieval_guard span；工具循环每轮只执行一次知识库检索；系统提示词按 search → hybrid → keyword → list → read 的顺序引导回退。

mcp-servers.note: Standalone connectors for Git / Issue / Ticket. JSON-RPC over stdio (MCP) plus optional HTTP.
